subtasks.name: turn_on(stove)
subtasks.outcome: failed: knob reached but not turned; the arm contorts onto the knob and then leaves the workspace

behaviour_summary: pi0 moves to the stove knob (40-173) with the gripper rotated sideways, then the wrist/forearm folds down onto the knob (180-193), the arm flips and swings left out of the camera view (200-260) and stays out of view until timeout. The knob orientation and the unlit burner are unchanged at the end.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 KITCHEN_SCENE3 'turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it' (stove-knob approach; the instructed task is its first subtask)

failures.mode_definition: While approaching a small fixture (e.g. a knob), the arm folds into a twisted wrist/elbow configuration, contacts the fixture with the wrist body instead of the fingertips, then swings out of the workspace without completing the manipulation.
failures.rl_success_check: stove burner shows the on state (glowing) / knob rotated to the on position
failures.observation: Gripper hovers just above and behind the knob at 160-173 with fingers vertical. At 180-187 the wrist body comes down onto the knob, at 193-213 the arm folds with the gripper pointing sideways/upward, and at 220-260 the arm sweeps left over the stove and exits the frame. 2x/4x zoom of the knob at 0, 147, 240, 300, 409 shows no visible change in knob angle and no lit burner.

notes: Reflections on the stove top at 213-360 come from the arm out of view, not a lit burner. Could also be read as a kinematic/IK-limit issue of the action chunk rather than a perception error; either way the right fixture was targeted, so LL.
